stem: Two rooms have the same relative humidity but different air temperatures. Why should their vapor pressure deficit not be assumed to be the same?
choices: VPD depends on the combined temperature and humidity state, so changing temperature changes the vapor-pressure relationship even when RH is unchanged
Relative humidity alone determines VPD regardless of temperature
VPD changes only when irrigation volume changes
rationale: VPD is derived from the relationship between saturation vapor pressure and actual vapor pressure, which means temperature and relative humidity must be interpreted together.
